main_idea: AQ warmup lifted Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7, near the teacher's 49.5.
summary: The GDPval bar chart is clear, but it is cluttered by three stat cards (two repeat the bars, one adds an unrelated throughput point), a blog tag and a second brand mark.
defects: Text in the 2.8 and ~6× cards spills below the card borders.
The dashed Teacher bar line overlaps its 49.5 label.
The footnote wraps onto a second line.
